training_summary: Compare IPOs using issue size, fresh/OFS mix, valuation, margins, debt, promoter holding, subscription and GMP together.
Separate live data from transcript evidence and prefer newer official/current sources.
When transcript values conflict, flag the conflict rather than silently correcting it.
For real-estate IPOs inspect project pipeline, execution risk, borrowing and profit concentration.
For manufacturing IPOs inspect customer concentration, margins, capex, working-capital/debt and promoter dilution.
For automotive technology/powertrain IPOs inspect OEM/customer concentration, product mix, EV exposure, capex, borrowing, interest burden, margins and valuation.
